A '''Mandalorian''' served in the [[Mandalorian resistance]] as a [[captain]]. The [[Mandalorian]] survived the [[Great Purge of Mandalore]] with a number of other [[Mandalorian survivors|resistance fighters]], and were forced to live off the [[crystal]]lized surface of [[Mandalore]] aboard a [[Langskib]] until they once again met with their leader, [[Lady]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]].<ref name="Chapter 23" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalorian captain appeared in "[[Chapter 23: The Spies]]," the penultimate episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season Three|third season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''. The captain was portrayed by [[Charles Parnell]] and is credited as "Survivor Captain."<ref name="Chapter 23" />
